data.one_liner: Shows an iOS‑style modal sheet that slides up from the bottom of the screen.
data.what_it_does: It displays content in a modal sheet that can be swiped to dismiss. The sheet adapts to mobile and tablet layouts, adding a dimming layer on tablets.
use_when: Need a native iOS‑style modal sheet
avoid_when: You need extensive testing or custom extensions

alternatives.name: modal_bottom_sheet
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar modal sheet functionality with more customization options
